name: caspule-nfsim-dimer
description: CASPULE bond-aware MD coupled to NFSim rule-based kinetics for a dimerization experiment. Type-1 monomers diffuse on a simple-cubic lattice and form bonds via LAMMPS fix bond/create. The ObservableDetector scans the bond graph each tick, extracts dimers (connected pairs), removes them from the spatial pool, and injects them as molecules into NFSim's non-spatial pool. NFSim then integrates reversible Dimer→Active activation and slow Active decay. This composite demonstrates two-way coupling between spatial MD and rule-based kinetics through the observable detector bridge.

config.input_script:
units lj
atom_style bond
boundary p p p
neighbor 0.5 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes
region box block 0 8 0 8 0 8
create_box 1 box bond/types 1 extra/bond/per/atom 4 extra/special/per/atom 50
mass 1 1.0
lattice sc 1.6
create_atoms 1 box
pair_style soft 2.0
pair_coeff * * 30.0
bond_style harmonic
bond_coeff 1 5.0 1.5
minimize 1e-4 1e-4 100 100
fix nve all nve/limit 0.05
fix lan all langevin 0.4 0.4 1.0 12345
timestep 0.005
fix mkbnd all bond/create 1 1 1 1.8 1 iparam 1 1 jparam 1 1
thermo 5

config.model_string:
begin parameters
    init_Dimer    0
    init_Active   0
    k_activate    0.1
    k_deactivate  0.05
    k_decay       0.01
end parameters
begin molecule types
    Dimer()
    Active()
    Decay()
end molecule types
begin seed species
    Dimer()    init_Dimer
    Active()   init_Active
end seed species
begin observables
    Molecules Dimer    Dimer()
    Molecules Active   Active()
end observables
begin reaction rules
    Dimer() -> Active()    k_activate
    Active() -> Dimer()    k_deactivate
    Active() -> Decay()    k_decay
end reaction rules
